q: Are you in a lab or on shared infrastructure?
why: This question comes first, before any technique. A desync can corrupt other users' in flight requests. On shared infrastructure that is not a test, it is an incident.

branches.action: stop. document the suspicion and the reason, then move to a lab. nothing else in this tree applies
